To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carenova.com>; CareNova Legal <legal@carenova.com>

Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form redlines: DPA transfer-addendum priorities and legal queue

Hi Elena / CareNova Legal team —

Thanks for the time on the call yesterday. Per our internal follow-up, I wanted to put the immediate asks for the MSA / Order Form package (DN-4217) in one thread so legal and procurement can coordinate on timing.

Top-line: CareNova has flagged three items that will materially affect signoff and runway: SCCs attachment, controller/processor role split in the DPA, and a narrow transfer-addendum for EU customer data routed through our analytics partner.

Attached: I uploaded an initial redline of the DPA and a proposed Order Form quantities change (see attachments and Drive link below). Please review the annotated DPA focusing on the role definitions (Sections 2–3) and transfer-addendum text (Annex B).

Immediate asks (can we please confirm by EOD Tue 22 Jul?):
- CareNova legal to confirm whether the suggested controller/processor split in §3 is acceptable or propose alternate language.
- Confirm if the SCCs in Annex A (we proposed the 2020 EU Standard Contractual Clauses with additional subprocessor notice) are acceptable or require DPA-level modifications.
- If CareNova needs a separate transfer-addendum, state the minimal info required (regional routing, fallback region list, and KMS obligations).

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal redline iteration (we’ll circulate a v2 on Mon).
2) Joint legal-to-legal call Wed 23 Jul — propose 30 minutes.
3) If agreed, we will prepare an Order Form final version and DocuSign envelope.

Please confirm who on your side should be on the call (titles preferred).

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carenova.com>

Cc: CareNova Legal <legal@carenova.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jul 2025 11:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form redlines: DPA transfer-addendum priorities and legal queue

Jordan —

Thanks for consolidating. We reviewed the annotated DPA briefly this morning with our privacy counsel. High level: the SCCs you propose look standard, but we need clearer commitments around subprocessor onboarding (notice vs consent) and an explicit KMS obligations paragraph if Redwood intends to manage keys for EU data.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Role split: We prefer to keep Article 3 language more neutral and rely on an explicit operations exhibit to avoid boxed legal positions in the MSA. Can you surface the proposed operations exhibit text?
- SCCs: Acceptable as a baseline; will propose two small edits (subprocessor notice timeline and logging requirements).
- Transfer-addendum: We will need the fallback region list and an SLA for routing failover. Also confirm whether any analytics partner will have access to raw EU PII (yes/no).

We can join Wed 23 Jul at 09:30 CET (that’s 00:30 PT) for a short legal sync — Elena Ruiz (Head of Legal, CareNova) and Miguel Alvarez (Privacy Counsel) will attend.

Can you confirm SOC 2 evidence and the encryption/KMS note? We have SOC 2 on file but would like a recent snapshot.

Regards,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Legal
CareNova

Folks —

I pulled together an internal pass and attached a marked-up DPA that:
- converts the role split into an operations exhibit (per Elena’s ask)
- narrows the transfer-addendum language to routing + fallback regions only (no blanket international processing clause)
- includes two alternate lines for subprocessor onboarding: notice (14-day window) or consent (explicit), with a preference recommendation for notice unless CareNova insists on consent.

Summary timeline / asks for legal:
- Internal sign-off on v2 by Tue 22 Jul COB PT.
- Legal-to-legal call Wed 23 Jul 09:30 CET (please publish calendar invite).
- If legal aligns, we target DocuSign send Fri 25 Jul.

Evidence: attached SOC2 snapshot and a short KMS note. If CareNova needs HSM details, we can loop infra.

Ben
